title: Item:Sentient Jewel of the Timid
wikitext:
{{Consumable
  | picdesc     = Sentient Jewel of the Timid.png
  | acquired    = Osah Lukresh
  | location    = Ravenloft Blue Water Inn
  | turnin      = 80 Vistani Totems
  | minlevel    = 20
  | bind        = {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}
  | effect      = A jewel that holds [[Sentient Weapon|sentient power]].
  | cost        = 500 pp
  | weight      = 0.01 lbs
  | stack       = <!-- Stack size for this consumable - default 100 -->
  | description = A jewel that holds sentient power. Click on the Sentient Item button on the right side of the inventory panel (or drag a weapon to that slot) to open the sentient Item panel.
  | notes       = Voiced by [[Cordovan]].
<hr>
:* On first slotting
:: (Say): ?
:* On first equip
:: (Say): "Just don't use me to hit anything sharp or hard. Please."
:* Random in combat
:: (Say): "It's not my fault! I had no choice in the matter."
:: (Say): "Sorry!"
:: (Say): "Sorry! It wasn't my fault! I had no choice!"
:: (Say): "Not bad!"
:: (Say): "I hope they don't take this personally." - Voice: "What was that? It didn't smell very pleasant."
:: (Say): "Time for you to rest forever. If only I too could rest."
:* On unequiping
:: (Say): "You don't want to use me? A wise choice!"
:* On feeding
:: (Say): "Well, that happened. Maybe you should retire me while I'm ahead?"
:: (Say): "No! Now I'm even MORE useful!"
:* On re-equipping
:: (Say):  Really? I was just getting comfortable!
:: (Say): "I don't suppose we're making breakfast, are we?"
:* On disabling a trap
:: (Say): ?
:* On looting a chest
:: (Say): "Wow! You'd look good wielding that."
:: (Say): "I'm sure one of these weapons will be better than me."
:* On weapon durability loss:
:: (Say): "You know, a better item wouldn't suffer this kind of damage."
:: (Say): *whimpers* - Voice: "Garoo"
:* On player losing health (below 1/2?)
:: (Say): "Umm, you don't look so good. I suggest a nice rest and a cup of tea, a long way from here."
:* Shrining
:: (Say): "We should stay here for a couple of days."
:* Quest acquisition
:: (Say): "Are we heading to a nice quiet place? Please say yes."
:* Quest completion
:: (Say): "Now that we're done, maybe it's time to retire from a life of adventure."
:* Party Member Death
:: (Say): "Someone needs to tell their loved ones who live far, far away. You should do that."
:* On player death
:: (Say): "I'm sorry for your loss. But isn't this much quieter?" - Voice: "I'm sorry for your loss."
:* On taking collectible
:: (Say): "You really want that?" - Voice: "Was that really a good thing to take?"
}}
